==Description==
The '''UAV''' is one of the three uncommon [[Consumables|consumables]]. The '''UAV''' has a 6.94% (6.76% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]] and a 11.54% (8.82% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]].

Only up to four '''UAVs''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 50 second cooldown, though when the match first starts the cooldown is set to 40 seconds. The cooldown does not appear until the '''UAV''' consumable has ended.

==Usage==
Unlike all other consumables, the '''UAV''' is instantly activated upon being chosen. This will cause the '''UAV''' to appear in the sky and circle the map for 30 seconds, giving all towers 30% more range, hidden detection and flying detection.

==Appearance==
The '''UAV''' is a grey MQ-9 Reaper. The inventory and hotbar icon shows the blue range icon in the top right corner to indicate that it is the '''UAV''' consumable.

==Strategy==
*If you do not have proper defenses to deal with hidden enemies, such as the [[Hidden]], [[Hidden Boss]], [[Shadow]] or [[Shadow Boss]] on their debut waves, the '''UAV''' can be used to allow other towers to detect them.
**This usage also applies for flying enemies, such as the [[Balloon Kid]].
**Beware that the '''UAV''' can only be used four times in a match per single player and lasts for 30 seconds per use.
*The '''UAV''' can be pretty useful in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, as it can give every tower flying detection on early waves like 22 or 33.
**This is especially useful as it can save a match if you forgot to upgrade your flying detection towers to higher levels, making them insufficient to deal with flying enemies.
